_comment: Keyword map for the 10-sector INDUSTRY_CATALOG used by AI Summarization's industryRelevance and the Emerging Threats aggregate heatmap (see server/aiThreatSummary.js and server/emergingThreatsRanking.js) -- deliberately a SEPARATE file from industry-map.json, which maps ransomware.live's own 4-bucket sector scheme for a different, older widget (Industries Targeted on Overview). Case-insensitive WHOLE-WORD match against a news article's title (see matchIndustries10() in server/emergingThreatsRanking.js) -- a plain substring match previously matched 'factory' inside 'Artifactory' (JFrog's product), misfiling unrelated DevOps stories as Manufacturing; word-boundary matching is why entries here don't need the old trailing-space hack ("bank ", "telecom ") to dodge false substring hits like 'database'/'telecommunication'. Anything matching none of these has no source-derived industry signal (falls back to whatever an AI Summarization report says, if one exists).
